title: 1dcat
description: Concatenates columns of multiple 1D or TSV/CSV files

input_files.description: Input 1D or TSV/CSV files to concatenate
input_files.title: Input files

tsv_output.description: Output in TSV format with tabs as separators and a header line
tsv_output.title: TSV format output

csv_output.description: Output in CSV format with commas as separators and a header line
csv_output.title: CSV format output

nonconst_output.description: Omit columns that are identically constant from the output
nonconst_output.title: Non-constant columns output

nonfixed_output.description: Keep only columns marked as 'free' in the 3dAllineate header
nonfixed_output.title: Non-fixed columns output

number_format.description: Specify the format of the numbers to be output
number_format.title: Number format

stack_output.description: Stack the columns of the resulting matrix in the output
stack_output.title: Stack columns output

column_row_selection.description: Apply the same column/row selection string to all filenames on the command line
column_row_selection.title: Column/Row selection

ok_empty.description: Exit quietly when encountering an empty file on disk
ok_empty.title: OK empty files
